## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `98ef7beec69da76fb36864d3a8d1aff641653e6a`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #33548 (body, claim 6889048768, os-dev-report 6889796521, claim amendment 6889808575), PR #33671 (body, 16 files, net diff against merge-base `d95ddebc`), and the 58 check-runs on the head as read at 2026-11-15T05:35Z. Face: declaration. The PR body and changeset say `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, and the tree touches no published schema and no governed path.

### ① Derived judgments

Public surface the diff publishes:
- **`ObjectGalleryProps.rowOpensRecord?: boolean`** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`, exported from `src/index.ts`). Optional, absent ⇒ `cardOpens` is true and the class list is the old one. **Right.** It is an additive widening, and it reuses #33544's name instead of adding a second one.
- **`ObjectKanbanComponentProps.rowOpensRecord?: boolean`** (`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, exported, and also exported under the deprecated `ObjectKanbanProps` alias). Optional, forwarded to `KanbanBoardCore` and then to `KanbanBoard`, where it defaults to `true` (`rowOpensRecord = true`). **Right.**
- **`KanbanBoardCoreProps.rowOpensRecord` and `KanbanBoardProps.rowOpensRecord`.** Neither type is exported from the plugin-kanban index; the index only imports `KanbanBoardCore` for its own `kanban` renderer, which passes no `rowOpensRecord` and so gets `true`. **Right**: these are internal and do not need declaring.
- **`ListViewProps.rowOpensRecord`** (published by #33544). Its type is unchanged. Its reach widens from `object-grid` to `object-grid | object-gallery | object-kanban` through `ROW_OPENS_RECORD_VIEW_TYPES`, still only when the prop is defined. **Right.** The jsdoc and README now say "the grid, the gallery and the board" in place of "Only the grid is handed it", so the docs match the code.

Accept-set and behaviour:
- **Phone card (`ObjectGrid` `grid-mobile-card`).** It drops `cursor-pointer hover:bg-accent/50` only when `rowOpensRecord === false`, and the onClick is kept. **Right.**
- **Gallery card.** It drops both the hover lift and the pointer when `rowOpensRecord` is false. Both `Card` branches (cover and icon-style) read the same `cardClass`. **Right.**
- **Board card.** The hover lift stays when `movable || opens`, and the cursor is `cursor-grab` when movable, `cursor-pointer` when it opens, and nothing otherwise. **Right**: the card's "draggable keeps its grab" note is kept.
- **⌘-click (`objectViewRecordNavigation.handleRowClick`).** The new `if (overlay.mode === 'none') return;` runs after `!served` and before the modifier check. Read against `detailNavigation`, `mode: 'none'` is reached on a served object only when the view or object explicitly authors `none` on a desktop: the phone branch returns `page` first, and an unserved object already returned. So the line changes exactly the authored-`none` modifier click and nothing else. A plain click under `none` was already a no-op in `useNavigationOverlay.handleClick` (`mode === 'none'` returns), so plain clicks are unchanged. **Right**, and it is the card's seat ruling made real.
- **Tests.** The new file has 9 cases. The #33317 pin is inverted with a drawer CONTROL for ⌘, Ctrl and `button: 1`. The dev's ablations (A1b–A5) each turned the matching pins red and left every CONTROL green. **Right.**

Findings:
- **should-fix (follow-up, not this PR).** On a board card that neither drags nor opens, the wrapper is still `role="button"` and a tab stop (dnd-kit `attributes`), Enter and Space still call `onCardClick`, and the title keeps `group-hover:text-primary`. This is the board's counterpart of the `role="link"` that #33317 removed from the grid. The card's acceptance is met as written (no pointer, and no tap target that *opens a record*), so this does not block. File it as its own small card if the seat wants assistive tech to stop announcing a control that does nothing.
- **nit.** The PR body ends with the harness footer instead of os-dev.md's footer form, as the dev's own deviation list says. "PR-body guards" is green. The seat may rewrite it; it has no effect on the contract.

Gates: on the head, 16 check-runs succeeded, 14 were skipped and 28 are still in progress (Type Check, Lint, Test UI and Test Core shards, Build & E2E UI, Build Docs, Check Changeset). None has failed. "Check PR Size", "Check Documentation Links", "PR-body guards", "Governed Surface Queue Guard", "Spec property liveness" and "Dogfood Regression Gate" are green. This record judges the contract, and landing still waits for the remaining runs, which the queue enforces.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33548-card-faces-open-nothing.md` takes `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-kanban`, `app-shell` and `console`, and it carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial. The PR body carries the same two lines.
- **Level.** **Right.** AGENTS.md rule 3 says a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`. Every package in the diff is in the changeset `fixed` group. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, and `@object-ui/console` is listed because it ships app-shell, the same precedent as the pending `33317-row-opens-nothing-plain` note.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`.** **Right.** Two exported Props types each gain one optional member, and nothing is removed or refused. The ⌘-click change is in the private app-shell host and makes the spec's own "No navigation (read-only list)" real for an authored `none`. It does not narrow any published type or accept-set, so `(narrowing)` is not owed. The seat's claim amendment 6889808575 already moved the claim line from `no` to `yes (widening)`.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`.** **Right.** No spec key, value or default changes. `none` keeps the meaning the spec already gives it; the runtime now honours it on one more click shape.
- The changeset says in words that it supersedes the #33317 note's "still opens the record in a new tab, as before" sentence, and leaves that file unedited. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- **needs_decision: on a phone, the #27058 rule runs before the authored `none`.** The question is whether a phone should honour an authored `none`. **Out of this card's scope; it should be a follow-up and escalated, not folded into this PR.**
  - Why: the card's Producer and Ruling name two defects, the card faces' styling and the ⌘-click handler, and its ruling is written about the modifier click. On a phone, a tap on an authored-`none` row is not a dead affordance today. `detailNavigation` resolves it to `page` because of #27058's explicit "whatever the view or the object declares", and the tap really opens the page. So the phone card keeping its pointer is correct for what the tap does, and the PR's styling tracks the click honestly.
  - Changing that order overrides a standing maintainer ruling (#27058), which is the maintainer's call, not a contract reviewer's or a dev's.
  - The phone-face pin covers list-only only, and that is the right consequence. It is not an acceptance gap.
  - Recommendation: file it as its own `needs-user-decision` card, with the dev's option A (an authored `none` returns `none` before the phone rule; one line plus a pin) as the recommended answer. The spec's "No navigation" and declaration-is-enforcement both favour A.
  - It would be p3 like this card, so under the owner's current p1/p2-only direction it is filed and parked, not dispatched.
- **Deviation: the file surface was wider than the claim.** It added `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, the kanban forwarding files, and the READMEs and docs pages. **Answered**: the seat's claim amendment 6889808575 lists every file, and `ObjectView.tsx` is untouched.
- **Deviation: Clause-② was measured `yes (widening)` against the claim's `no`.** **Answered**: the amendment adopts it, and ② above confirms it.
- **Deviation: the footer form.** **Answered** as a nit in ①.
- **Deviation: the app-shell suite was narrowed locally to 113 files.** **Answered**: the full suite is CI's, and its Test UI shards are still in progress on the head, so landing waits on them.
- **out_of_scope: the compact and capped list postures** (`ListViewCompactRows`, `ListViewCappedRows`) are not handed `rowOpensRecord`. **Agree with not filing**: the console object list does not mount them, and no host passing a `none` navigation to them was measured. Revisit only if a host is found.
- **out_of_scope: a real middle click fires `auxclick`.** **Agree with no action.** No row or card handler listens to `auxclick`, and the only element that took a native middle click (the name-cell anchor) is gone under `rowOpensRecord: false`. The pins drive `click` with `button: 1`, which is the shape `handleRowClick` reads.
- **Ordering.** The card said "Lands after PR #33544": #33544 is merged (`beff1fbf`), so this is satisfied. #33549 (the `useNavigationOverlay` `preventNavigation` line) is held behind this card, and the diff leaves the hook untouched, as that hold requires.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `6ae0b07ab561d6fbbaae0b3229b5b123a3422a7b`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #33548 (body, claim 6889048768, os-dev-report 6889796521, claim amendment 6889808575), PR #33671 (body, 16 files, net diff against merge-base `d95ddebc`), the round-1 record 6889845772 (PASS on `98ef7bee`), the delta `98ef7bee..6ae0b07a` (two commits: `e22e358e` with the fix, and `6ae0b07a` with docs prose only), and the 36 check-runs on the head as read at 2026-11-15T05:56Z. Face: declaration. The PR body and changeset still say `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. The tree touches no published schema and no governed path. There was no rebase: the merge-base is still `d95ddebc`, and the file list is the same 16 files.

### ① Derived judgments

**Round-1 should-fix: fixed, and fixed right.** In `KanbanImpl` `SortableCard`, `control = movable || opens`. On a card with `control` false:
- dnd-kit's `attributes` are not spread. The card loses `role="button"`, `tabIndex=0`, `aria-roledescription`, `aria-disabled` and the `aria-describedby` drag hint. None of these means anything on a card that neither drags nor opens.
- The explicit `role` and the inner `aria-label` are left undefined. The outer `role="listitem"` keeps `aria-label={card.title}`, so the card is still named once and the list structure stays intact.
- `onKeyDown` and `onKeyUp` return before Enter or Space can reach `onCardClick`.
- `group` moved into the `control &&` class arm. The two `CardTitle`s' `group-hover:text-primary` was the only thing reading it, and no ancestor in `KanbanImpl` or `KanbanBoardCore` carries a `group` class. So the title hover goes, and a hover anywhere else does not light it.
- `{...listeners}` is still spread, but `useSortable({ disabled: !movable })` gives no listeners for a card that cannot be dragged (the objectui#12082 note on the same lines). `onClick` and `data-kanban-card` stay, so the host still gets the click, as the card requires.

**Every other combination is byte-identical to round 1.**
- Absent `rowOpensRecord` (the context default is `true`): `control` is true and the old markup is kept. This covers the `kanban` renderer, the Studio canvas and every other caller that does not pass the prop.
- A draggable card: `movable` is true, so it keeps the button role, the tab stop and dnd-kit's attributes. The new pin asserts this.
- An opening card that cannot be dragged: unchanged.

**Pins.** The board block of `ObjectView.cardFacesOpenNothing-33548.test.tsx` grows from 9 to 12 cases:
- New for authored `none` and for list-only, on a card the reader may not drag: no `role=button` with `tabindex=0`, and no `group` with `group-hover:`.
- New for a draggable card under `none`: it keeps the button role and the tab stop.
- New CONTROL (default drawer): role, tab stop and title hover are present, and Enter opens `?recordId=c1`.

Read against the round-1 code, the new non-control assertions fail there (the attributes and `group` were applied unconditionally), so they discriminate. The CONTROL legs hold on both heads.

**Public surface: unchanged.** `ObjectKanbanComponentProps.rowOpensRecord` and the internal `KanbanBoardProps.rowOpensRecord` change only their jsdoc, which now describes the new behaviour. No type, export or default moves. The changeset and both READMEs (`plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`) match the code. `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` says the same thing in reworded prose, which is what `6ae0b07a` changed. On `e22e358e` the "Reserved-word ("role") docs ratchet" step had failed "Lint · docs & code guards", and that is the reason for the reword. `plugin-list.mdx` keeps its round-1 sentence ("no pointer and no hover lift"), which is less detailed but still true.

**Round-1 ① judgments stand unchanged** for the phone card, the gallery, the `ListView` forwarding set, the ⌘-click return in `objectViewRecordNavigation.handleRowClick`, and the #33317 pin.

Findings:
- **should-fix (round 1): resolved** in `e22e358e`, inside this PR rather than as a follow-up. This is in scope: it only affects the `rowOpensRecord: false` path that this PR introduces, and it serves the card's acceptance ("no tap target").
- **nit.** The `!control` guards in `onKeyDown` and `onKeyUp` are not pinned by any test, and nothing observable depends on them: a card with no tab stop cannot get keyboard focus, so no key event ever targets it. They are harmless defence in depth. The "ignores Enter and Space" claim in the docs is true either way.
- **nit.** The objectui#12883 comment above the JSX still says, with no condition, that the card "is a tab stop … so it is a control … a `button`". The new comment on `control` a few lines up gives the exception, but the old one now reads as stale.
- **nit.** The PR body predates the delta:
  - "9 cases", "18 green" and the two-minute check's "18" are now 12 new cases and 21 in total.
  - The board bullet and the ablation table do not mention the dropped role, tab stop or title hover, and the ablations were run on `98ef7bee`.
  - "Verification" is stated on `98ef7bee`.
  
  None of this affects the contract.
- **nit (round 1, carried).** The PR body uses the harness footer form. "PR-body guards" is green on this head.

**Gates.** On the head: 8 succeeded, 10 skipped and 18 are in progress. None has failed.
- Green: "Type Check · workspace", "PR-body guards", "Governed Surface Queue Guard", "Check PR Size", "Check Documentation Links", "Spec property liveness".
- In progress: "Lint · docs & code guards" (the lane that failed on `e22e358e`), "Lint · ESLint", "Check Changeset", "Build Docs", "Dogfood Regression Gate", and the planning of the Test UI and Test Core shards.
- "Test UI" on `e22e358e` reads failure because its shards were `cancelled`, which matches a run superseded by the `6ae0b07a` push.

This record judges the contract. Landing still waits for the remaining runs, which the queue enforces.

### ② Semver level

**Unchanged and still right.**
- `.changeset/33548-card-faces-open-nothing.md` keeps its frontmatter: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-kanban`, `app-shell` and `console`. Only its prose paragraph changed, to describe the board card that is no control. Both declaration lines still start their lines, and they match the PR body.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: right.** The delta adds no member and removes none. The dropped role and tab stop apply only when `rowOpensRecord` is `false`. That prop is new in this same PR, so no published behaviour narrows: every caller that does not pass it renders exactly as before.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** No spec key, value or default is touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

The delta raises no new dev flag and no new `open_questions` entry. Round 1's answers carry forward:
- **needs_decision: does a phone honour an authored `none`?** (`detailNavigation` runs the #27058 phone rule first.) **Still escalated, not folded in.** Changing that order overrides a standing maintainer ruling. Recommendation: its own `needs-user-decision` card, with the dev's option A (an authored `none` returns `none` before the phone rule). It is p3, so under the owner's current p1/p2-only direction it is filed and parked, not dispatched.
- **Deviations** (wider file surface, Clause-② measured `yes (widening)`, footer form, app-shell suite narrowed locally): **answered** as in round 1. The delta adds no file outside the amended surface: all 7 files it touches are already in claim amendment 6889808575's list or in the original claim.
- **out_of_scope** (compact and capped list postures; `auxclick`): **agree, no action**, as in round 1.
- **Ordering.** #33544 is merged. The diff still leaves `useNavigationOverlay` untouched, which keeps #33549's hold intact.

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `6ae0b07a` · 2026-11-15T06:20Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #33548`. 16 files. All of it is on the amended surface (6889808575):
   - the phone card face in plugin-grid `ObjectGrid.tsx`
   - gallery (`ObjectGallery`) and board (`ObjectKanban`, `KanbanImpl`, `KanbanBoardCore`) faces read an optional `rowOpensRecord`, and `ListView` forwards it
   - the ⌘/Ctrl/middle-click branch in app-shell `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` opens nothing for an authored `none` row
   - three READMEs, three docs pages and one changeset
2. **Premise.** The dev measured each face on `origin/main` and named its deciding line. The fix follows the card's seat ruling: under `none`, no click opens a record. The `ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317` pin now expects nothing on ⌘-click. A list-only object keeps its existing behaviour.
3. **Contract records.**
   - Round 1: PASS 6889845772 on `98ef7bee`, with one should-fix. A board card that neither drags nor opens was still a button and a tab stop.
   - The fix landed in `e22e358e`. `6ae0b07a` rewords the `plugin-kanban.mdx` prose for the role-word docs gate.
   - Delta: PASS 6890050048 on `6ae0b07a`, nits only. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and `patch` is right.
4. **Gates on head `6ae0b07a`.**
   - 60 check runs: 48 `success`, 12 `skipped`, 0 failed.
   - Locally: 21/21 pins, ablations red and restored, and the derived gates reconciled with `--ran`.
5. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The PR body ends with the harness footer.
   - The body's test counts predate the board fix (the delta record's nit). It is a prose face, so it does not move the head.
6. **Out of scope.** On a phone, an authored `none` list still opens the record page, because the #27058 phone rule runs before the authored mode. That changes a standing ruling, so it is the maintainer's call. It is not in this PR and will be filed as a decision card.
7. **K.** 41 first-parent commits since base `d95ddebc` ≥ 15, so I synced the base: a merge of `main` at `d4e3dcc6`, new head `b616c8c2`. The sync is merge-only; patch-id `4e3d1d290f88` is the same on both heads. The landing waits for the rerun to go green.
8. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
